excerpt.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着[This.GetName]。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
excerpt.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the [This.GetName]. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

texts.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着[This.GetName]。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
texts.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the [This.GetName]. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

texts.zh: 在我们的各个星球上，一种难以言喻的恐惧笼罩着所有人。人们对自己的生活感到愈发苦恼、烦躁和不满。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象凶兆引起的。
texts.en: There is an inexplicable sense of looming dread throughout the population on our worlds. The people are feeling more distressed, distracted, and dissatisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.
